---
title: "Test the Design by Simulation"
---

Simulate data from your DAG with a known effect, fit models with different adjustment sets, and plot which ones recover the truth. Plot the DAG you simulate from, including any variable you add. See `docs/reference/simulate-from-dag.qmd`, which uses a smaller DAG than yours. Use it as a pattern.

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(dagitty)
```
